headline: Congress goes quiet for the week—both chambers in pro forma sessions Thursday with no votes or business scheduled.

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate convened briefly in pro forma session on Monday, August 10, and adjourned immediately. No legislative business was conducted. The chamber will return for another pro forma session Thursday morning before the August recess.

house.lastSessionSummary: The House met for two minutes on Monday, August 10, with Speaker pro tempore Foxx presiding. Twelve new bills (H.R. 10070-10081) and three resolutions were introduced, and 15 Senate bills were held at the desk. No votes were taken. The House will convene in pro forma session Thursday before the August recess.
